blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Senate impeachment court on Tuesday denied the House prosecution panel’s request to admit Vice President Sara Duterte’s bank records as evidence. It cited the Bill of Rights, particularly the right against self-incrimination. READ: Prosecution, defense teams clash anew on Sara Duterte’s bank records This came after the House prosecution panel submitted a request for admission on Sept. 8 covering Duterte’s personal circumstances and former public offices, her spouse Manases Carpio’s business interests, and various tax and bank records. The defense panel then objected and sought to expunge the request. In ruling over the matter, Presiding Officer and […]...
